scope.word_population: only rows currently lacking a complete directional hardware-bank match

candidate.failure_pattern: Configio RTA half-words have no complete directional bank-to-module match; numeric suffixes occur in multiple catalog families and are not an authoritative slot or bank key.
observed_facts: Aggregate binding summary reports 19 no_eipmodules_bank_match words, distinct from 89 BOUND words.
At word 23, Low bank 6 encounters a 1746-IA16 input module while the Configio descriptor is 1746-OA16; High bank 7 has no bank match.
At word 2072, neither banks 88 nor 89 exists on any hardware module.
candidate.candidate_rule_description: Do not infer an adapter, slot, directional bank, or half-word relationship from the terminal numeric suffix in Configio Desc. Preserve the existing requirement for a complete, direction-compatible hardware bank match; route rows lacking it to review.

steps: Parse Desc only for a non-authoritative catalog prefix and numeric suffix.
Require each usable Configio half to match a hardware bank of compatible direction and catalog where catalog evidence is available.
Require evidence for one coherent word-level binding; otherwise retain review status.
Never use numeric suffix as a rack selector, slot selector, bank conversion, or Low-to-High pairing rule.

supporting_examples.observation: Low bank 6 is present only as input bank on T_1747_AENTR_1 slot 5 (1746-IA16), contradicting its 1746-OA16 Desc; High bank 7 has no match.
Banks 88 and 89 have no hardware module-bank match despite Desc suffixes 127 and 128.
A BOUND word exists for 1746-OA16 Desc suffixes 4/5 and banks 0/1, so descriptor syntax alone does not identify a universal numeric conversion.
A BOUND 1794-IA16 word uses Desc suffixes 95/96 and banks 68/69, unlike unbound 1794-AENT suffix/bank ranges.

counterexamples.reason: Unbound rows span 1746, 1794, and YASKAWA descriptor families; no common hardware topology supports a single catalog-numeric/Low/slot mapping.
Word 23 Low bank 6 points to a direction-incompatible input module and High bank 7 is absent.
Word 2072 suffixes 127/128 pair with banks 88/89, neither present in the hardware bank map.

ambiguities: No raw convention links Configio numeric suffixes to adapter identity, slot, or bank for unbound forms.
The aggregate cluster combines heterogeneous descriptor families and partial/full half-word failures.
YASKAWA descriptors have no demonstrated directional-bank correspondence in the hardware map.
additional_evidence_needed: Authoritative raw cross-reference mapping every affected Configio bank/descriptor to adapter identity and directional module bank.
For partial words, raw evidence defining whether an unmatched High or Low half is intentionally absent and its relationship to the other half.
Hardware/source export containing bank records for missing 88/89, 136–139, 216–219, and 266–269 ranges if those banks are expected.
tests_required: Apply guard to all 108 Configio words and verify independently BOUND words remain unchanged.
Verify every affected half has compatible directional bank match before allowing non-review outcome.
Reject any binding based solely on Desc numeric suffix, half position, or inferred adjacent bank.

confidence.basis: Strong evidence numeric-suffix fallback is unsafe; no evidence supports a positive resolver convention.

evidence_purity.reason: comparison/diagnostic against a candidate — not independent proof
